subject: Request for help in solving installation errors of Amber

messages.author: dhruvi.iiar.res.in
messages.body:
Hello sir,
I am trying to install AmberTools19 and during installation I got this error-
Import Error: No module named setuptools
Makefile:505: recipe for target 'pytraj' failed
make[2]: *** [pytraj] Error 1
make[2]: Leaving directory ' /mnt/c/Users/Hp/amber18/AmberTools/src'
Makefile:26: recipe for target 'serial' failed
make[1]: *** [serial] Error 2
make [1]: Leaving directory ' /mnt/c/Users/Hp/amber18/AmberTools/src'
Makefile: 7: recipe for target 'install' failed
make: *** [install] Error 2
Please help me
Regards,
Dhruvi Shah
LTMT-JRS
Immunology Lab
IAR, Gandhinagar

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Mon, Apr 20, 2020, dhruvi.iiar.res.in wrote:
>Sorry to disturb you but miniconda is successfully installed and yet it
>shows the same error.
I can be difficult in a long email thread for readers to know what the
"same error" is.
If it is this one:
>>> Import Error: No module named setuptools
then it is likely to be a problem with your environment. Did you run
"source $AMBERHOME/amber.sh" in the same shell in which you are
compiling? What is the result of typing "echo $PYTHONPATH"?
....dac
